stops.name: Pointe du Raz
stops.detail: The Pointe du Raz (Breton: Poent ar Raz) is a promontory that extends into the Atlantic from western Brittany, in France. The local Breton name is Beg ar Raz. It is the western point of the commune of Plogoff, Finistère.
